name: – Isabella Lövin – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text:
The European Parliament says the Baltic Sea is in crisis and current fishing rules have failed. It asks the European Commission and member states to act now: pause fishing for some stocks until they recover, set catch limits that follow scientific advice, protect small coastal fishers, and give them financial support. It also wants better science that looks at the whole ecosystem, action on pollution, dumped munitions and seals and cormorants, and a possible revision of the rules. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and member states to act and to consider revising the rules.
- **Who it affects:** Baltic fishers, especially small-scale ones, coastal communities, and the fish stocks they depend on.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to follow these requests; any legal change needs a new proposal.
